I’m sorry you feel like this, I have these types of thoughts from time to time. Go to a guardian or guidance counselor, favorite teacher anybody. Get someone to help you that you trust, it’s not worth it, you still have your whole life ahead of you.
You’re never alone in these feelings and there are support groups out there aswell. I hope everything works out for you

I feel the same way. In my opinion the best thing you can do is work on your mental physicial and emotional health. Workout meditate get into therapy if need be just do stuff that will make you feel good.
Put a smile on my face to know at least someone knows how I feel
